decision: Generated secret_dance remains unaccepted for normal hardware use after observed jitter. This diagnostic does not identify a proven cause or promote a replacement.
scope: Read-only analysis of two archived physical trials plus a six-second logged Sit-hold comparison; no new motion, training, gain or policy changes.
user_observation: User explicitly watched generated trial2 and described slow movement and jitter like low frame rate. Trial1 was not visually evaluated.
hardware_validation: Attempted but not accepted; software completion is not physical-quality approval.
findings: Intentional timing explains the slow overall sequence: a5.96s reference plus initialization/fade and walking-controller handoffs. It does not explain or excuse the reported jitter.

Both generated playback windows contain joint/IMU telemetry at roughly4ms median header intervals; maximum joint gaps are9.73ms and13.30ms. Logged policy inference is approximately49Hz with no interval above30ms. These observations do not support sustained low-frame-rate inference starvation during playback. They do not prove actuator timing.
One-time telemetry gaps around initialization/return reach roughly46–57ms; their origin is not established and they must not be treated as proven actuator pauses.

Generated playback has greater measured velocity and 2–8/8–20 Hz position/gyro content than the requested Sit-hold and returned-locomotion windows. Intended movement differs, so these are descriptive comparisons, not a controlled causal test or an acceptance threshold.

All extracted linear_acceleration fields are exactly zero. A sampled covariance array is also allzero (unknown covariance), not an explicit unavailable flag. Treat this acceleration stream as noninformative; never infer absence of vibration.

No position-command, policy-output or policy-observation stream was recorded. The bag cannot distinguish command oscillation from tracking response, quantization, friction/stiction or other motor dynamics.
Root-reported81.8C temperature and0x80000 historical soft-temperature flag were not timestamp-aligned to these trials; thermal causation is not established.

next_actions.action: Retain generated trick as unaccepted; use no additional generated hardware runs solely to fill this report.

Prepare a later supervised bounded diagnostic capturing timestamped policy_output, observation, post-limit position_command if exposed, joint_states and IMU, with synchronized video and temperature/clock samples. Preserve names/order and distinguish commanded from measured motion.

In simulation compare unchanged policy at nominal52Hz/fixed16msdelay against measured cadence and plausible timestamped observation-delay variation. Record target increments, tracking error, torque, contacts and endpoint behavior; this tests timing sensitivity without retraining.

Only if evidence points to command roughness, compare a bounded smoothing or existing slew-contract candidate in simulation against unchanged policy, preserving action-history and clamp semantics. Do not alter gains or silently filter on hardware.

method.phase_assignment: Log-time phases inferred from activation messages plus nominal0.5s initialization and1s fade; not exact measured posture boundaries. Sit comparison uses middle6s of logged completed10s wait.
method.spectral_method: 100Hz interpolation, mean removal and Hann window;2–8/8–20Hz RMS diagnostic bands. Suppressed for median source interval>20ms,p95>25ms ormaxgap>50ms. Header time preferred; receive/header deltas retained.
method.decoded_samples: Selected JointState/Imu fields retained asJSONL; full rawCDR/schema/covariances remain in original immutableMCAP.
method.parser_validation: Synthetic200-messageMCAP verified10ms cadence,1ms receive/header offset,.2rad/s velocityRMS and10Hz position sinusoid RMS; syntheticdata are not robot evidence.
method.joint_band_aggregation: Square root of the mean of the12 per-joint band RMS values squared, then radians-to-degrees conversion; not arithmetic mean.
method.returned_controller_identity: Extraction phase keys default_initialization_fade/default_after_readiness refer to the logged return to gemini_walk (using the stock policy), not activation of neural_controller_default.

limitations: Two generated physical trials; trial1 was not watched. No population-level robustness claim.
Comparators have different intended behavior and lengths; do not attribute their signal differences solely to bad policy behavior.
Recorded velocity/effort are telemetry fields, not independently calibrated metrology. Quantization and stable-pose noise remain.
Interpolation and finite windows affect frequency estimates. No validated numerical threshold maps them to the subjective jitter report.
Inference log timing and ROS-message timing are not direct actuator deadlines.
Archived current inputs remain separate from earlier nominal simulation identities.

independent_review.verdict: No mismatch or causal/physical-pass overclaim found;40reported metrics across5comparison rows recomputed.
independent_review.review_scope: Report content before adding this review metadata; measurements and interpretation unchanged.
